visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing denim overalls over a white t-shirt, stands in a stadium seating area. She smiles broadly at the camera, performing a cute choreographed dance that includes making a heart shape with her hands. The background features a brightly lit green baseball field at night with red stadium seating. (2) The camera cuts to a second young woman with her brown hair in twin pigtails, wearing a floral spaghetti-strap dress. She gestures playfully, pointing to herself and swaying her body to the rhythm while maintaining an energetic facial expression. The stadium background remains consistent with multiple food containers visible on the foreground table. (3) A third woman with long brown hair, dressed in a white crop top and black trousers, takes the center. She performs a hair toss and various dance poses with high energy and a cheerful, beaming smile. The lighting from the stadium floodlights creates a bright, high-contrast environment around her as she moves dynamically. (4) In the final segment, all three women appear together in the frame. They smile, laugh, and wave enthusiastically at the camera. They perform a synchronized concluding pose, making finger hearts and peace signs against the backdrop of the illuminated sports field, showing strong group chemistry and high energy.

The vocal delivery is sharp and synchronized perfectly with the steady percussive beats. The background music maintains its major-mode tonality and upbeat atmosphere throughout this segment without any incidental noise interference. (3) The sequence continues as a third female voice enters, proclaiming "Shiki-chan! Hai!" with an animated and exuberant delivery style. The speech rate is fast and rhythmic, matching the high arousal level of the previous segments. The music continues to layer melodic synth pads over the constant, punchy kick drum and snare patterns. (4) The audio culminates with all three voices joining in unison to shout "Minna! Hai!" followed by a concluding rhythmic phrase "Mochiron daisuki ice cream!". The music increases in intensity for the finale, with the vocals and electronic instruments blending into a bright, celebratory peak before a hard cut at the end.
